text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You were invited to observe the training 
of Little Cocon, another Umamusume trained 
by Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Supporting her as she hones her stamina as 
her greatest weapon is Darley Arabian, who 
values individuality above all else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Darley Arabian's knowledge combined with 
Trainer Kashimoto's managerial skills 
allows for the most optimal training 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running through the Twinkle Series, Little 
Cocon and Trainer Kashimoto set their 
sights on the grand stage of the Classic 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make that goal a reality, they both 
resolved to hone their respective weapons 
more than ever before.
